hero.title: Buy and sell across Haiti
hero.lead: MaurMaket brings Haiti's marketplace online. Find what you need, talk directly with sellers, pay securely with MonCash or NatCash, and meet up to exchange — all in one app, in Kreyòl, French, or English.

features.heading: Why MaurMaket
features.sub: Everything the market already does — formalized, safe, and simple.
features.f1Body: Message sellers directly, share photos, and agree on a price — the way haggling already works, without leaving the app.
features.f2Body: Pay at checkout with MonCash, or pay the seller directly with NatCash when you meet. No cash hunts, no surprises.
features.f3Body: Arrange a meetup with an agreed place and time, check in when you arrive, and confirm the exchange with a code.

steps.heading: How it works
steps.sub: Three steps from browsing to handoff.
steps.s1Body: Search listings across Haiti, or open your own shop in minutes — free to start.
steps.s2Body: Talk directly with the other party, negotiate, and agree on the price and meetup details.
steps.s3Body: Pay with MonCash or NatCash, meet at the agreed spot, and confirm the handoff.

about.heading: About MaurMaket
about.lead: Haiti runs on informal commerce — in group chats, on street corners, and across market stalls. MaurMaket gives that energy a proper home: a marketplace built for how Haiti actually buys and sells.
about.s1Body: Kreyòl, French, and English from day one. Prices in gourdes. Meetups where you actually meet.
about.s2Body: Verified sellers, public reviews on completed purchases, and an order history that follows every account.
about.s3Body: Chat, offers, photos, payments, and meetups stay in one place — no more chasing a seller across five group chats.
about.v1Title: Your money waits for the item
about.v1Body: MonCash payments are held until the exchange is confirmed, so buyers and sellers meet as equals.
about.v2Body: Free to start, clear fees, and payouts straight to your MonCash.
about.v3Body: Meetup check-ins, report tools, and human review when something goes wrong.
